scope: Selected main danger-brain decision branches, not complete LAMBS addon/source-tree parity. No runtime or performance acceptance.

branches.source: brain classifies native causes into immediate, hide, engage and assess; empty queue synthesises ASSESS.
branches.cbe: DangerEngineSelect bounds48 records; DangerEngineMode classifies local native task/domain before cause. DangerEngineSubmit forwards at most12 observations with original expiry and separate source witness.
branches.disposition: Implemented source intent with bounded intake and stricter evidence; not a timing or behavioural equivalence claim.

branches.source: brain selects fire/hit/explosion/bullet-close immediate response, conditional on friendly source and suppression.
branches.cbe: DangerEngineAct applies finite weak posture and gated native evasions; DangerStep wakes group planning; CortexGroupTick calls DangerCoverStep. Movement and owned tasks remain separate authority.
branches.disposition: Execution paths exist. Full brainReact/doCover/doDodge descendants are outside this selected review; do not mark complete parity.

branches.source: brainEngage invokes doAssault directly for a nearby living foot target; STEALTH/hold-fire/fast target/unknown target/planner state defer.
branches.cbe: Actor FSM handles posture; CONTACT group branch gives coordinated assault first refusal, then CortexBuildingContact, then IndoorActorDispatch for available actors. Native beliefs and per-actor executor authority are retained.
branches.disposition: Different execution placement. A direct doAssault-equivalent call in DangerEngineAct would introduce another movement owner. Real path readiness/latency/flow remain unverified.

branches.source: brainEngage invokes doSuppress for a still, ready CANFIRE actor beyond minimum range, except tight formations.
branches.cbe: CortexFireControl consumes matching finite CANFIRE/contact evidence through group scheduling, with bounded actor lanes, ammo/fire-policy/native-task gates.
branches.disposition: Existing suppression executor is the intended owner. Source eligibility/balance and actual suppression cadence are not established by registration or presence of a CANFIRE label.

branches.source: brainHide watches a scream position, investigates own-group casualty, seeds building memory on another body, and otherwise lowers stance; rare indoor reposition.
branches.cbe: DangerEngineAct uses finite glance/stance and PointActorOperation for corroborated own-group casualties. DangerStep seeds bounded BODY_FOUND clue; group observation/search paths dispatch indoor work.
branches.disposition: Actor/group evidence split is intentional. Missing body object is not death provenance. Physical investigation and repeated entry/return still require evidence.

branches.source: brainAssess consumes groupMemory via doAssaultMemory, can randomly reposition indoors, otherwise sets weak middle stance.
branches.cbe: ASSESS does not manufacture fresh group threat evidence. Search and clue memory are consumed by finite indoor actor/group tasks; known-contact dispatcher has an8s selection interval and2-actor capacity.
branches.disposition: Deliberate redesign instead of random unleased movement or unconditional authored-stance replacement. The2-actor investigation capacity is not whole-squad CLEAR capacity; do not conflate them.

branches.source: brainForced handles fleeing, forced movement and ATTACK pacing/stance; removes a SuppressTarget attack object.
branches.cbe: DangerEngineMode preserves concrete boarding/care/action/supply tasks; ordinary ATTACK remains combat-enabled. DangerFlight and DangerAttackPace supply finite response/restoration paths.
branches.disposition: Do not copy unconditional target deletion/watch reset. Required external-controller handover and retained native order retirement are separate unresolved contracts.

currentTimingEvidence.dangerWake: DangerStep sets existing brain wakeAt/nextAt to current time at most once per0.5s and carries responsiveUntil; not measured execution latency.
currentTimingEvidence.indoorAdmission: IndoorActorDispatch admits at most2 individual investigators, selection throttled8s. Whole-group clearance is a separate task.
currentTimingEvidence.performance: No measurements while audits paused; bounded loops alone do not prove5% median/10% p95.

nextImplementationBoundary: Continue required native operation/controller handover and coherent CQB actor-ready ownership, rather than adding a second direct actor movement/suppression writer merely to mirror LAMBS function placement.

immediateEvasionFootingFollowup.scope: Existing prone/upright native lateral reactions now share obstruction and footing vetoes. Earlier sourceHashes remain historical; follow-up records current actor source. Not full doCover/doDodge or danger parity.
